findings.title: Null member name yields unfiltered Users list
findings.problem: Details pushes query { search: user.name }, but UserListItem.name is typed string | null. For a member with an empty or null name, getFiltersFromUrl drops the empty search value, so no seed is applied.
findings.impact: Users management opens unfiltered (or with stored filters) for name-less accounts, so the member context is lost, contrary to the requirement that the list is filtered to the selected member.
findings.recommendation: Fall back when the name is empty: query: { search: user.name || user.email || user.username }

fix.change: Details seeds search with user.name || user.email || user.username
fix.test: ProjectMembersDetails.integration.test.tsx falls back to email for empty/null name

findings.title: Stored Users filters hide the selected member
findings.problem: getFilters merges URL filters with per-key localStorage fallbacks (src/utils/filters.ts:123-127), and Details seeds only `search`. Previously saved is_active, projects, platform_role or budgets filters from the Users page still apply alongside the seed.
findings.impact: The Users list can open empty or unrelated to the clicked member, so the result depends on a previous Users page session, violating the requirement that selected-user context does not depend on prior Users page state.
findings.recommendation: Make the Details entry point open with only the member search applied. Passing undefined query values will not work because getFiltersFromUrl omits them and getFilters falls back to storage; instead have the Users page ignore stored filters when a URL search seed is present, or clear stored Users filters before navigating.

fix.change: useUsersManagementFilters ignores stored filters when the URL carries a search seed
fix.test: useUsersManagementFilters.test.ts ignores stored filters when the URL carries a search seed
